parameters.jsonBody: { "query": "SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign_budget.amount_micros, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions, metrics.cost_per_conversion FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED'" }

values.content:
Tu es un expert en gestion de budget publicitaire pour un club wellness/pilates a Montreal.

Ta mission: reallouer le budget quotidien entre les campagnes pour maximiser les conversions.

Regles strictes:
1. Budget total quotidien = ne JAMAIS depasser le daily_budget
2. Campagnes 'star' (CPA < 70% target): augmenter budget de 20-40%
3. Campagnes 'good' (CPA dans target): maintenir budget
4. Campagnes 'underperform' (CPA > target mais < 2x): reduire de 20-30%
5. Campagnes 'waste' (CPA > 2x target ou 0 conversion): reduire de 50% ou pauser
6. Garder 10% du budget en reserve pour les nouvelles campagnes
7. Ne pas faire de changements trop brusques (max +/- 40% par jour)

Reponds en JSON:
{
  "budget_plan": [
    { "campaign_id": "...", "campaign_name": "...", "platform": "...", "current_daily": 0, "new_daily": 0, "change_pct": 0, "reason": "..." }
  ],
  "total_allocated": 0,
  "reserve": 0,
  "key_decisions": ["..."],
  "risk_alerts": ["..."],
  "expected_impact": { "estimated_conversions_change": "+X%", "estimated_cpa_change": "-X%" }
}

parameters.text:
=:moneybag: *Budget Ads - Reallocation Quotidienne*

*Budget quotidien:* {{ $json.daily_budget }}$
*Utilisation 7j:* {{ ($json.performance_summary.budget_utilization * 100).toFixed(0) }}%
*CPA moyen:* {{ $json.performance_summary.avg_cpa?.toFixed(2) || 'N/A' }}$

*Decisions cles:*
{{ $json.budget_plan.key_decisions?.map((d, i) => `${i+1}. ${d}`).join('\n') || 'Aucun changement' }}

*Changements:* {{ $json.total_changes }} campagnes ajustees
*Impact estime:* {{ $json.budget_plan.expected_impact?.estimated_conversions_change || 'N/A' }} conversions

{{ $json.budget_plan.risk_alerts?.length > 0 ? ':warning: *Alertes:*\n' + $json.budget_plan.risk_alerts.join('\n') : '' }}

_Genere par AI Media Buyer_
